pack_generation_fixture_tree_sha256.domain_separator: ASCII contextguard.progressive-fixture-tree.v1 followed by one zero byte
pack_generation_fixture_tree_sha256.entry_encoding: For each sorted regular file: 8-byte big-endian UTF-8 path length, path bytes, 8-byte big-endian content length, content bytes
pack_generation_fixture_tree_sha256.note: The private pack-generation file does not declare this custom algorithm. Independent audit reproduced every pack byte-for-byte; the study manifest separately binds each canonical fixture tree and file mode.

study_manifest_bytes.note: The private manifest has the repository-required single trailing LF and exactly matches the canonical serializer output.

limitations: The 12 instances come from two synthetic templates and are not 12 independent workload families.
The two-arm design tests a combined adaptive-k plus symbol-memory workflow and cannot attribute either mechanism's incremental effect.
Both arms retain workspace fallback; retrieval, turns, latency, and cache behavior are part of the observed result.
Correction burden and a fully loaded shifted-cost confidence interval are unavailable.
The private pack-generation rows use a custom fixture-tree hash algorithm that is documented in this summary but not declared in that evidence file.
The result is scoped to this source revision, corpus, Claude Code version, model alias, and cache conditions.

local_pack_timing.design: one warmup per task and arm; five counterbalanced repetitions; one process per measurement

operational_spend.note: The first run was discarded after detecting a noncritical prompt-to-fixture path drift; it supports no result.

arms.treatment: ordinary auto pack with explicit --apply-adaptive-k and --apply-symbol-memory
